semantics.identity_rule: Each material match result has explicit evidence identity.
semantics.candidate_rule: Candidate IAM/Portfolio identity ref is exact.
semantics.score_rule: Scores/ranks are derived evidence and not canonical competence truth.
semantics.explanation_rule: Reason/features may be represented without exposing prohibited private data.
semantics.expiry_rule: Match freshness/evidence lifetime is explicit where inputs change.
semantics.authority_rule: Match does not create contract/Project membership.

invariants.rule: Composition never silently transfers semantic ownership: universal modules own their primitives, domains own their composition semantics, and composed members retain their own identities and contracts.

Containment, relation, dependency, composition and projection edges exist only through explicit typed references; naming, file hierarchy, UI adjacency or shared values never create semantic structure.
